holdout_rule: Only open C5/C6 odd-ID holdout after development gates pass. Compare both models once at unchanged thresholds; no automatic production promotion.
limitations: Development data were already seen in the flip experiment; this is model selection, not blind testing.
C5/C6 holdout uses odd IDs and separate cameras, but the same recording; some identities appeared in older C1/C2 diagnostics.
GT crops only: no detector, tracking or end-to-end camera handoff evaluation.
Pretrained model comparison only; no project-specific training or metric learning.
